interface.name: zwwm_screencopy_view_manager_v1
interface.description: Captures completed output compositions and reports presentation timing. Global visibility is compositor policy outside this wire contract.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Existing frame objects remain valid one-shot snapshots and must still be destroyed by the client.

request.name: capture_output

description.summary: capture the current completed output composition

request.description: The compositor captures without the cursor unless overlay_cursor is non-zero. An unsupported cursor overlay produces a nonfatal unavailable failure on the frame.

request.name: capture_output_region
request.description: Coordinates are in the output's logical coordinate space. The compositor clips the region to the output extent and advertises the resulting physical pixel size after scale and transform. An empty clipped region fails with unavailable.

event.name: cursor_modes

description.summary: cursor modes supported by this compositor backend

event.description: Sent once after binding. Embedded is omitted when the active backend cannot capture a compositor-owned cursor, including nested mode where the parent compositor owns the visible cursor.

event.name: presented

description.summary: a new output composition was presented

event.description: Sent after presentation completion. Stream clients should coalesce these events and request a capture only when their consumer has a released buffer. The timestamp uses CLOCK_MONOTONIC.

interface.name: zwwm_screencopy_frame_v1
interface.description: The compositor sends buffer and flags before the client copies. A frame accepts exactly one copy request, using a wl_shm buffer matching the advertised format, dimensions, and stride. ready or failed is terminal; clients must destroy the frame after either terminal event. The source is always compositor output, never a captured client's backing buffer.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroying before a terminal event cancels interest in the snapshot and no further events are sent for this object.

request.name: copy

description.summary: copy into the advertised wl_shm buffer

request.description: Supplying a non-SHM buffer or one whose format, size, stride, offset, or storage is insufficient is a protocol error. A second copy is a protocol error. Source loss, compositor inability to capture, and capture cancellation are nonfatal failed events instead.

event.name: ready
event.description: The timestamp uses CLOCK_MONOTONIC and identifies the completed compositor snapshot copied into the client buffer.

description.summary: capture could not be completed or was revoked
